issues.display_title: Issue #65: feat: Support AI Chat Analytics - Session Tracking & Countly Telemetry Integration
issues.main_description_html:
Description

To accurately calculate Total Sessions and track conversational continuity in the upcoming AI Chat Analytics dashboard for Support accounts, the chat widget must generate and maintain a persistent session_id throughout a conversation.

Requirements & Scope

  • Session ID Generation: Generate a unique UUID v4 (session_id) when a conversation begins or upon the first message.
  • Persistence Across Conversation: Keep the active session_id in state/storage for ongoing follow-up questions within the same thread.
  • Payload Integration: Inject session_id into the POST /copilot/chat payload in Chat.tsx.
  • Countly Telemetry Integration: Include session_id in Countly event tracking payloads (trackClientActionOffered and trackClientActionTriggered) to correlate action events with chat sessions.
  • Lifecycle Reset: Reset and regenerate the session_id when the user clicks the "New Session" button or when the session is cleared.
  • Build Asset: Ensure the bundled widget output is updated.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Every chat request to /copilot/chat contains a valid UUID session_id.
  • Countly client action events contain the matching session_id.
  • Starting a new session creates a brand new unique session_id.
  • No regression on existing chat and action triggering flow.
